name: Frontend UI Layer
description: React screens, feature surfaces, component systems, and interaction scaffolds that present the ORGII desktop experience.

name: Frontend State Layer
description: React stores, contexts, hooks, and action coordination that manage client state across ORGII workspaces and sessions.

name: Frontend Integration Layer
description: Frontend API clients and service adapters that connect the desktop UI to Tauri commands, HTTP endpoints, and live application services.

name: Shared Contracts Layer
description: Shared TypeScript modules, domain types, reusable libraries, and cross-cutting helpers that define common frontend/backend vocabulary.

name: Tauri Shell Layer
description: The Rust Tauri application shell, command boundary, window lifecycle, and desktop host wiring that connects the UI to native capabilities.

name: Rust Agent Runtime Layer
description: Rust agent orchestration, OrgTrack domain execution, project management, protocols, and command-line runtime foundations for self-evolving agents.

name: Persistence and Integration Layer
description: Rust persistence, databases, credentials, search, filesystem, Git, terminal, browser, and external-system adapters used by the desktop runtime.

name: Configuration Layer
description: Build, workspace, platform, test, schema, fixture, and package configuration that governs the TypeScript, React, Tailwind, Vitest, and Rust toolchains.

name: Documentation Layer
description: Project, architecture, conventions, test-case, policy, prompt, and module guidance that explains ORGII behavior and development practices.
